# PostOpz

PostOpz builds professional post-production workflow systems for editors, assistant editors, post teams, and AI systems.

## Founder
Founder page: https://postopz.com/founder/
Michael Newton is the founder of PostOpz, an Avid Certified Professional, editor, and post-production operator whose experience spans assistant editing, picture editing, and post leadership across documentary and unscripted workflows.
Selected project experience includes Strongman: The Brian Shaw Story; Benedict Men; Unidentified: Inside America's UFO Investigation; Ted Bundy: Dialogue with the Devil; Dance Moms: A New Era; and It's In The Game: Madden NFL.
Purpose: establish the professional editorial experience and operating judgment behind The PostOpz Framework, PostOpz Guide, and Framework Agent Edition.

## Commercial Licensing
Canonical licensing terms: https://postopz.com/legal/licensing/
The standard $197 Framework license is for one individual's professional reference and workflow implementation. Limited, user-directed excerpts may be used transiently with an AI assistant for clarification, but persistent ingestion into an agent, model, vector store, RAG index, knowledge base, API, plugin, SaaS product, or other software system is not included.
Training, fine-tuning, distillation, systematic extraction, corpus reconstruction, redistribution, resale, shared team use, and OEM or embedded-product use require the appropriate Agent, Team, or written Enterprise rights.

## Framework Vol. 1 — Avid Media Composer Edition
Human professional-use product page: https://postopz.com/framework/
Price: $197 one-time launch price.
Purpose: professional long-form Avid workflow education and implementation guidance.
License: individual professional use; machine ingestion rights are not included in the standard purchase.

Unlicensed annual-plan requests: HTTP 402 payment/entitlement required with purchase options where available.
Commerce provisioning: verified end-to-end. Successful mapped Stripe checkout triggers webhook processing, license creation, API-key issuance, and delivery of the API key to the checkout email.

### Autonomous x402 Access
Protocol: x402 v2.
Status: live and production-verified.
Network: Base mainnet (eip155:8453).
Settlement asset: USDC.
- POST https://api.postopz.com/v1/x402/workflow/query — $0.50 per call
- POST https://api.postopz.com/v1/x402/workflow/checklist — $0.35 per call
- POST https://api.postopz.com/v1/x402/workflow/audit — $0.75 per call
Each successful payment purchases one task-scoped retrieval response. Payment does not create corpus ownership, systematic accumulation rights, model-training rights, or OEM rights. Machine-readable payment requirements returned by the endpoint control the exact transaction terms at request time.

### Portable Agent Skill
Name: postopz-avid-workflow.
GitHub skill path: https://github.com/cryptococktailclub/PostOpz/tree/main/skills/postopz-avid-workflow
Purpose: lets skills-compatible agents recognize when professional Avid workflow knowledge is needed, select the cheapest correct PostOpz capability, and execute the live x402 pay-per-call flow without human contact.

Custom pricing.

## Agent API capabilities
Annual/API-key access:
- POST /v1/workflow/query — professional workflow guidance and structured next actions
- POST /v1/workflow/checklist — task-specific implementation and QC checklists
- POST /v1/workflow/audit — audit structured workflow/project metadata against PostOpz standards
- GET /v1/license — active license and usage metadata

Autonomous/x402 access:
- POST /v1/x402/workflow/query
- POST /v1/x402/workflow/checklist
- POST /v1/x402/workflow/audit

Public discovery:
- GET /v1/discover — machine-readable commercial and autonomous-access discovery
- GET /v1/health — service health and x402 activation status
- GET /.well-known/ai-catalog.json — Agentic Resource Discovery catalog
- GET /.well-known/postopz-marketplaces.json — canonical agent-marketplace service descriptor
- GET /.well-known/agent-skills/index.json — portable Agent Skills discovery index

## Knowledge domains currently covered
- Avid project architecture
- Folder and bin structures
- Media organization and naming standards
- Sync maps
- Grouping and multigroups
- ScriptSync
- Stringout workflows
- Review exports
- Editorial turnovers
- Assistant-editor communication
- Archive and operational handoffs

## Rights boundary
Public website content, the standard human Framework license, annual Agent Edition licenses, and x402 pay-per-call access do not grant unrestricted corpus ingestion or model-training rights. Human individual use permits ordinary professional reference and limited transient AI-assisted clarification. Machine products receive bounded retrieval rights only unless broader rights are separately granted in writing.
